content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All pay scales below are as per the 6th Pay Commission and describe the grade (darja) of officers from which each post is to be filled. Managing Director: Officers in a field office subordinate to a Mantralaya department, in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 7600/- (Pay Scale Rs. 15600-39100). Associate Managing Director: Officers in a field office subordinate to a Mantralaya department, in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 6600/- (Pay Scale Rs. 15600-34800). Chief Financial Officer: Officers from the Accounts Officer cadre in a field office subordinate to the Finance Department, in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 6600/- (Pay Scale Rs. 15600-34800). Manager: Officers in a field office subordinate to a Mantralaya department, in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 6600/- (Pay Scale Rs. 15600-34800). Private Secretary to Hon. President: Officers in a field office subordinate to a Mantralaya department, in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 4400/- (Pay Scale Rs. 15600-34800). Accountant: Officers in a field office subordinate to a Mantralaya department, in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 2800/- (Pay Scale Rs. 5200-20200). The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the proforma only asks applicants to state their educational qualification. The notice also does not mention an age limit, though the proforma asks for the date of birth and the date of retirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The deputation proforma asks for the following details and documents: Full name and designation of the officer or employee Pay scale in which pay is currently drawn Name, address and telephone number of the present office Date of birth, date of first appointment and date of retirement Educational qualification Contact details (mobile number and email ID) Photocopies of the confidential reports of the last five years from 2025-26 Whether the statement of assets and liabilities (as on 31.03.2026) has been submitted Whether the 50/55-year review has been done Details of any earlier deputation: period (from date to date), post and place of deputation (office) Whether a departmental enquiry is ongoing or proposed Whether the officer has earlier been found guilty in a departmental enquiry or by a court Whether the department will relieve the officer if selected for deputation Name, designation and signature of the Head of Department

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised in Jain Alpsankhyak Vikas Arthik Mahamandal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Six posts are advertised, one each of Managing Director, Associate Managing Director, Chief Financial Officer, Manager, Private Secretary to Hon. President and Accountant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The willingness application in the proforma must be submitted by 04 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these deputation posts?
faq.answer: Applications are invited from officers and employees in the equivalent pay scale working in field offices subordinate to Mantralaya departments of the Government of Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for the Chief Financial Officer post?
faq.answer: Officers from the Accounts Officer cadre in field offices subordinate to the Finance Department, in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 6600/- (Pay Scale Rs. 15600-34800), are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale of the Managing Director post?
faq.answer: The Managing Director post is in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 7600/- and Pay Scale Rs. 15600-39100.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale of the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The Accountant (Lekhapal) post is in the 6th Pay Commission scale with Grade Pay 2800/- and Pay Scale Rs. 5200-20200.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Jain Alpsankhyak Vikas Arthik Mahamandal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the attached deputation proforma and submit it with your Head of Department's approval by 04 December 2026, as per the GAD Government Resolution dated 17.12.2016.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents are needed with the application?
faq.answer: The proforma requires photocopies of confidential reports of the last five years from 2025-26, the status of the assets and liabilities statement as on 31.03.2026, and details of any earlier deputation, enquiry or court finding.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent appointment?
faq.answer: No, the posts are to be filled by appointment on deputation from officers already in Maharashtra government service.
